threats.threat_description: An attacker captures and replays or forges RF response messages to the vehicle RF transceiver to impersonate the legitimate key fob, bypassing authentication and allowing unauthorized vehicle entry or engine start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and engine start.

threats.threat_description: Compromise or side-channel leakage from the key fob's cryptographic keys or response data could reveal secret key material, enabling cloning or unauthorized access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0040: Unsecured Credentials to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or theft.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel Analysis / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or floods the RF channel preventing the key fob from communicating with the vehicle RF transceiver, denying legitimate access or start attempts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall ensure the Availability of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle access and engine start.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or modification of the LF antenna could generate false wake/proximity signals or suppress legitimate signals, causing unauthorized unlock attempts or denial of service.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and denial of service for authorized users.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Physical Tampering Test / Signal Integrity Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker transmits forged LF wake/proximity signals that are accepted by the LF antenna and forwarded to the LF receiver, triggering unsolicited challenge flows and potentially draining vehicle battery or enabling relay attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized vehicle wake-up, battery drain, and facilitation of relay attacks.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the LF antenna signal space, preventing detection of the legitimate key fob and denying access or start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of access or start for legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering with the vehicle RF antenna or its analog RF feed could enable relay attacks, signal amplification, or antenna spoofing, resulting in unauthorized vehicle access or engine start.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the RF Transceiver to Vehicle Antenna RF Link and RF Challenge-Response Messages against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine start.

threats.threat_description: An attacker physically intercepts or probes the RF antenna feed to eavesdrop on challenge/response messages, potentially enabling cryptanalysis or replay attacks.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: Physical damage or obstruction of the RF antenna can prevent proper RF communication, denying key fob authentication and vehicle access.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Availability of the RF Transceiver to Vehicle Antenna RF Link against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent loss of keyless entry and start functionality for legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: Compromise or firmware modification of the RF transceiver can allow an attacker to forge, modify, or drop forwarded RF authentication data, bypassing authentication or causing denial of service.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, starting, or denial of service.

threats.threat_description: Unauthorized access to the RF transceiver firmware or internal state could leak cryptographic responses or vehicle secrets to an attacker.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Transceiver Firmware and Auth Data against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker can jam or disrupt the RF transceiver's ability to receive or transmit challenge/response messages, causing authentication failures and vehicle lockout.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate user lockout and denial of vehicle access or operation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker with access to the RF transceiver control interface could cause it to transmit unauthorized challenges or responses, confusing the BCM or enabling unauthorized unlock/start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the BCM to RF Transceiver Control Interface and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: A compromised BCM firmware could bypass authentication logic, issue unlock or start commands without proper verification, or escalate privileges to control other ECUs or HSM APIs.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware in BCM, CAN Lock/Unlock Message, and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, engine start, and compromise of cryptographic operations.

threats.threat_description: An attacker could modify the BCM's configuration or firmware to alter access policies, disable challenge-response checks, or forward unauthorized tokens to Door or Start ECUs.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of BCM Configuration and Firmware against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: The BCM logs or audit trails might be insufficient or tampered with, allowing denial of unauthorized unlock/start commands or failure to detect misuse of tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Accountability of BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent undetected tampering with audit trails and denial of unauthorized unlock or start command attribution.

threats.threat_description: An attacker could flood the BCM with false LF wake events or crafted RF responses causing exhaustion of processing or denial of legitimate authentication attempts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal and Auth Data against Manipulate Communications to prevent denial of keyless entry and start functions for authorized users.

threats.threat_description: Sensitive data such as cryptographic keys or tokens processed by the BCM might be leaked via debug interfaces or compromised firmware, allowing attackers to clone keys or forge tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Start Authorization Token and Auth Data against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized vehicle start or keyless entry.

threats.threat_description: A compromised Door ECU could accept unauthorized unlock commands or manipulate actuator signals to unlock doors without valid tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command and CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized unlocking of vehicle doors.

threats.threat_description: Physical or firmware tampering of Door ECU could allow bypassing access control checks or modifying actuator control signals to unlock doors.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Actuator Signal against Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry.

threats.threat_description: Flooding the Door ECU with invalid or malformed unlock/lock commands could prevent legitimate commands from being processed.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent temporary loss of ability to lock or unlock doors using normal vehicle interfaces.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of the Start Authorization ECU could allow an attacker to enable engine start without valid authorization tokens, bypassing security controls.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Engine Start Command and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and operation.

threats.threat_description: Firmware or configuration tampering could allow the ECU to accept invalid tokens or ignore token expiration, enabling unauthorized engine starts.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine starts.

threats.threat_description: An attacker could block or corrupt messages from BCM to Start Authorization ECU causing denial of engine start even with valid authentication.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of In-Vehicle CAN communication against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized denial of engine start with valid authentication.

threats.threat_description: CAN bus is a broadcast medium; an attacker with access to the bus could eavesdrop on unlock/start commands and tokens, potentially enabling replay or cryptanalysis attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of In-Vehicle CAN messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: Injection of forged CAN messages by an attacker with bus access could allow unauthorized unlock/start commands or disruption of vehicle functions.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of In-Vehicle CAN messages against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle control and disruption of safety-critical functions.

threats.threat_description: Bus flooding or error frame injection on the CAN bus can cause denial of service to ECUs communicating unlock/start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of In-Vehicle CAN (broadcast medium) against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of unlock and start functionality for vehicle users.

threats.threat_description: A compromised HSM firmware or API could allow unauthorized extraction of cryptographic keys or generation of forged authorization tokens without valid authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0027: Exploit Isolated Execution Environment Vulnerability to prevent unauthorized extraction of keys, generation of forged authorization tokens, and privilege escalation within the vehicle's secure domain.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware and API Security Assessment

threats.threat_description: Malicious modification of the HSM firmware or secure boot measurements could undermine trust in the secure enclave, allowing subversion of cryptographic operations or key protection.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of HSM Firmware, Secure Boot Measurements, and HSM Attestation Data against ATM-T0023: Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent loss of trust in the secure enclave and unauthorized cryptographic operations.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Integrity Verification / Secure Boot Validation

threats.threat_description: Insufficient logging or tamper protection in the HSM's API calls could allow denial of unauthorized token generation or key usage.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Non-repudiation of Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent untraceable unauthorized token generation or key usage.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Audit Log Review / Penetration Testing

threats.threat_description: Side-channel attacks or firmware compromise could leak cryptographic keys or sensitive token data stored inside the HSM.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized decryption, token forging, and loss of trust in secure vehicle communications.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel Analysis / Firmware Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: A DoS attack on the HSM, such as exhausting its crypto engine or blocking API calls, could prevent legitimate verification or token generation, denying vehicle access or start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being denied vehicle access or start.

threats.threat_description: Modification of the crypto engine logic or its interaction with the key store could allow bypassing cryptographic verification or forging tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized token forging, key extraction, and bypass of cryptographic verification.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Code Review / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: Leakage from internal crypto engine operations could reveal key material or intermediate cryptographic states to an attacker.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized access to protected communications and stored data.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel Analysis / Fault Injection Testing

threats.threat_description: Unauthorized modification or deletion of cryptographic keys or lifecycle metadata could invalidate authentication or allow unauthorized token creation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall enforce the Integrity, Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized token creation, authentication bypass, or denial of service to legitimate users.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Access Control Review

threats.threat_description: Extraction or leakage of cryptographic keys from persistent storage compromises all vehicle authentication mechanisms.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, control, or cloning.

threats.threat_description: An attacker who compromises Door ECU or actuator control signals could force the Door Lock Actuator to unlock doors without authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking of vehicle doors.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering with the Door Lock Actuator wiring or control signals could cause unauthorized unlocking or denial of locking.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door ECU to Actuator Signal against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking or denial of locking.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle (Door ECU to Door Lock Actuator Wiring)

threats.threat_description: A compromised engine ECU could enable engine start commands without valid authorization from the Start Authorization ECU.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Engine Start Command and Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle starting and defeat of immobilizer controls.

threats.threat_description: Blocking or tampering with start enable commands from Start Authorization ECU to Engine ECU could prevent engine start even when authorized.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent authorized users from being unable to start or use the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects forged LF wake/proximity events to the BCM via the LF receiver, causing false challenge initiations and potential battery drain or relay attacks.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link
threats.atm_technique_name: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the LF Receiver to BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0030: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation to prevent unauthorized BCM wakeup, increased risk of relay attacks, and vehicle battery depletion.

threats.threat_description: Physical or firmware tampering with the LF receiver could suppress legitimate wake signals or generate false events, causing denial of service or unauthorized unlock attempts.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of BCM Event / Control Link against Physical Modification to prevent denial of service or unauthorized vehicle unlocking.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Physical Inspection / Firmware Integrity Check

threats.threat_description: Relay attacks exploiting the Wireless Communication Boundary (ANT_RF_1, RF_1, ANT_1) allow an attacker to extend the effective range of the key fob signals by forwarding LF and RF signals between the vehicle and a distant key fob, bypassing proximity checks and enabling unauthorized entry or start.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Wireless Communication Interface shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of LF Proximity Signals and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Inconsistent or weak authentication enforcement across BCM_1, ECU_START, and Door ECU on the CAN bus allows attackers with bus access to inject or modify unlock/start commands, exploiting the broadcast nature of the CAN bus despite token/MAC protections.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM_1), ECU_START, and Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock and Engine Start Commands on the In-Vehicle CAN bus against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Exposure of cryptographic keys or authorization tokens at any component (Key Fob, HSM, BCM, RF Transceiver firmware) or on communication assets (RF messages, CAN bus messages) enables cloning or token forgery, compromising the overall system security.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle Authentication System shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0040: Unsecured Credentials to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Analysis / Firmware Review

threats.threat_description: Attackers could flood or jam communication channels crossing trust boundaries (LF antenna to LF receiver, RF antenna to RF transceiver, CAN bus) or exhaust ECU processing resources, resulting in denial of legitimate unlock/start attempts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle Communication Interfaces shall enforce the Availability of LF Proximity Signal, RF Challenge-Response Messages, and In-Vehicle CAN against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent authorized users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Lack of secure logging or audit trails across BCM, HSM, and ECUs allows attackers or insiders to deny having performed unauthorized unlock or start actions, complicating incident response and forensic analysis.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM, HSM, and ECUs shall enforce Accountability, Non-repudiation, and Traceability of BCM Configuration and Access Policies and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent denial of unauthorized unlock or start actions and to support effective incident response and forensic analysis.

threats.threat_description: Compromises in any ECU firmware or the BCM, possibly through insecure firmware update mechanisms or vulnerabilities, could allow attackers to elevate privileges and issue unauthorized unlock/start commands or manipulate cryptographic operations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and all ECUs shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Availability of Firmware and Secure Boot Measurements against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, theft, and compromise of cryptographic secrets.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / Firmware Update Interface (Wired and Wireless)
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware Integrity Verification / Secure Boot Validation
